title: Exotic Egyptian Chicken Tagine
description: A rich and cozy Egyptian dish featuring chicken, nutmeg, and dried fruits, perfect for a cold evening, this recipe is low in calories and can be made with dehydrated ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, ground coriander, and ground nutmeg, and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the dried apricots, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
